questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Security-critical deployments require verifiable runtime integrity. This tests knowledge of kernel integrity (IMA), secure deployment workflows, and integration with systemd and CI.

## Key Concepts
- Linux IMA and runtime attestation
- Signed binaries in CI and secure repositories
- systemd integration (ExecStartPre) and rollback mechanisms
- Tamper-detection tests and observability

## Code Example
```bash
# validate-binaries.sh (conceptual)
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_HASH=$(cat /etc/ci/signatures/service.sha256)
ACTUAL_HASH=$(sha256sum /usr/local/bin/myservice | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$ACTUAL_HASH" != "$EXPECTED_HASH" ]; then
  echo "Signature mismatch" >&2
  exit 1
fi
```

```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/myservice.service (snippet)
[Unit]
Description=My Critical Service

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/myservice
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/bin/validate-binaries.sh
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle CI/CD with multiple binary variants across environments?
- How would you monitor and alert on attestation failures in production?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical expertise in real-time Linux systems engineering, specifically CPU isolation, interrupt management, and deterministic scheduling under load. It assesses a candidate's ability to design hardware topology-aware solutions that guarantee audio processing latency requirements.

## Key Concepts
- CPU isolation with isolcpus and nohz_full for deterministic execution
- IRQ affinity management and irqbalance service control
- cgroups v2 hierarchy with dedicated real-time slices
- SCHED_FIFO real-time scheduler with priority management
- Memory locking strategies for preventing cache misses and swapping
- Performance validation using cyclictest and synthetic workloads

## Code Example
```bash
# GRUB configuration for CPU isolation
GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="isolcpus=4-7 nohz_full=4-7"

# Systemd rt.slice configuration
[Slice]
CPUQuota=100%
CPUAffinity=4 5 6 7
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryLimit=infinity

# Real-time service configuration
[Service]
Slice=rt.slice
CPUSchedulingPolicy=fifo
CPUSchedulingPriority=99
LimitMEMLOCK=infinity
```
